map.实际税率与法定税率为何不同？: Why does the effective tax rate differ from the statutory rate?
map.法定税率是名义档，实际税率受优惠、扣除、亏损结转等影响，通常低于法定税率。: The statutory rate is the nominal bracket; the effective rate is affected by incentives, deductions, loss carry-forward, etc., usually below the statutory rate.
map.ETR 越低越好吗？: Is a lower ETR always better?
map.不一定，过低的 ETR 可能来自一次性减免或暂时性差异，需结合可持续性判断。: Not necessarily; an excessively low ETR may come from one-off relief or temporary differences and needs judgement together with sustainability.
